deadline.value: The GSLS programmes have no vacancies of their own; posts are found through the university and UMC Utrecht vacancy pages.
deadline.quote: Vacancies can be found at the UU website and UMC Utrecht website.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: A supervisory team must be in place before the PhD can start.
supervisor.quote: Before you can start your PhD, you should have a supervisory team.

funding.value: PhD candidates in the Netherlands are in most cases university employees rather than students.
funding.quote: As a PhD candidate in the Netherlands, you are not a student but a university employee in most cases.

entry_route.value: A master or equivalent degree is needed to be admitted to the PhD track.
entry_route.quote: A master or equivalent degree is needed to be admitted to the PhD track.

notes: The 15 GSLS programmes include Clinical & Experimental Neuroscience (neuro) and Cardiovascular, Medical Imaging and Regenerative Medicine (biomed). A PhD appointment is needed before joining a GSLS programme, so the programmes are not an admission route. Blocked (403): https://www.uu.nl/en/education/graduate-school-of-life-sciences/phd/prospective-phd-candidates .
